title: Cheapest Gyms Rotorua
meta_desc: Find the cheapest gyms in Rotorua with no contract options and prices. Compare gym deals and learn about Exercise NZ subsidies for discounted memberships.
intro: Rotorua's gym scene offers affordable options for fitness enthusiasts. With various chains and community centres, residents can choose from several budget-friendly choices. Contours is the cheapest and best value option, with no-contract alternatives available.

sections.heading: No-Contract Gym Options in Rotorua
sections.body: For those who prefer flexibility, Contours offers a no-contract membership option. This allows members to cancel their membership at any time without incurring penalties. Additionally, Les Mills and City Fitness offer similar flexible membership options, although they may not be available in Rotorua. It's essential to check with each gym for their specific policies.
list: Les Mills: no lock-in contract, but not available in Rotorua
City Fitness: month-to-month membership, but not available in Rotorua

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Programme
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers 40-70% off gym memberships for eligible members. This is the biggest discount available for those who are new to exercise or have been inactive for 12 months or more. To be eligible, members must meet specific criteria, including being a New Zealand resident and not having been a gym member in the past 12 months.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Finding an affordable gym in Rotorua is possible, with options like Contours offering no-contract memberships and cheap prices. Remember to check the Exercise NZ subsidy programme for potential discounts and compare prices before making a decision. Always read the terms and conditions before signing up for a gym membership.
